findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Good company, built in." → 3 lines (4 words, 39px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "A LITTLE TOUR" above "Come on in."; "A LITTLE BETTER, TOGETHER" above "Small steps. Shared momentum."; "A FRIENDLY PUSH" (pill) above "Cheer each other on."; "YOUR PEOPLE" (pill) above "Make room for your people."; "YOUR OWN PACE" (pill) above "Keep a rhythm, not a streak of perfectio"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: DM Mono — e.g. "Product walkthrough · interactive previe"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 12 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "A LITTLE TOUR", "SAMPLE CONTENT", "Up next", "CIRCLE STANDINGS").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 🌿 💛 ✓ ✳
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): section.landing-close → linear-gradient(115deg, rgb(48, 41, 33), rgb(46, 41, 37) 55%, rgb(51, 39, 37))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 12 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: section#demo.landing-demo → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.533) 0px 22px 70px 0px | button.selected → rgba(71, 55, 44, 0.125) 0px 1px 4px 0px | div.device-frame → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.733) 0px 26px 70px 0px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07) 0px 1px 0px 0p
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 11 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): nav.landing-nav 1320px | aside.landing-real-sidebar 145px | div.landing-real-top 975px | section.day-glance 931px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 13 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: Terracotta / rust-orange accent (button #e07a45).
findings.fix: Use the accent from the drawn palette.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "💛 2" 1.1:1 (#f2f2f2 on #ffffff); "kinda" 1.8:1 (#44362d on #000000); "Morgan" 2.1:1 (#aaaaaa on #f4f1ec); "Today’s leaderboard" 2.3:1 (#504943 on #080808)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.

findings.message: 5 typefaces in use (DM Sans, Georgia, Fraunces, Manrope, DM Mono).
findings.fix: Two at most: one display, one text. Often one is enough.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 22 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: 2 h1 elements.
findings.fix: One h1 per page; section titles are h2.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 8 different lines (199px, 170px, 327px, 971px, 99px, 269px, 706px); the three most used hold only 54% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.
